title.narrative: To contribute to achieving Vision 2030 through universal access to comprehensive HIV prevention, treatment and care

description.narrative: Kenya - HIV - The National Treasury & Economic Planning of the Government of Kenya - TNT. This program has the following goals: To provide comprehensive HIV prevention, treatment, care and support towards Universal Health Coverage for all people in Kenya. The objectives of this program are: Reduce new HIV infections by 75%. Reduce AIDS related mortality by 50%. Micro-eliminate viral hepatitis and reduce the incidence of sexually transmitted infections. Reduce HIV related stigma and discrimination to less than 25%. Increase domestic financing for the HIV response to 50%
